stories.headline: Delhi Police reportedly used Meta AI glasses at Oct 10 protests
stories.subtitle: Medianama reports Delhi police used Meta's smart glasses at Oct 10 protests, raising questions about whether officers can wear camera glasses on duty and record people without authorization. A fresh surveillance angle customers may ask about.

stories.headline: Valve sets Steam Frame delivery windows: 2026 or 2027
stories.subtitle: Reservation holders now see a December-2026 or 2027 window depending on when they reserved; Valve also released the headset's CAD files for 3D printing.

stories.headline: Sony sells 419 VR patents to Meta — PSVR3 looks unlikely
stories.subtitle: ZDNet Korea reports 43 patents reassigned June–September as part of the December 2025 deal; neither company has commented. Shedding VR patents is a strong signal Sony is stepping back from a PSVR3.

stories.headline: Pimax unveils wireless Crystal Pro with foveated streaming
stories.subtitle: Native Foveated Streaming sends the gaze region uncompressed while the periphery stays light; its 60GHz AirLink claims 6 Gbps and under 2ms latency — aimed squarely at high-end PCVR users.

stories.headline: Samsung's smart glasses clear FCC; November launch expected
stories.subtitle: Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear — the Gentle Monster and Warby Parker editions — passed FCC approval: audio-only, camera-equipped, ~46g, about 9 hours active use plus case recharges, running Gemini on Android XR. Price still unannounced.
